736.title: Every user gets 100 AI calls; after that each AI request says the budget is over and whom to contact
humanItems: As a platform admin, open the dashboard page `/dashboard?tab=metadata` and scroll to the card «ניהול משתמשים»: each user row shows «מכסת AI» with a number (100 for a user never changed) and «נוצלו N». Set a test user's number to 2, press «שמור»: the toast «מכסת ה-AI עודכנה» shows, and after a reload the row still says 2.

Sign in as that test user (allowance 2) and create a recipe with AI twice: both work. The third try shows the toast «מכסת השימוש שלך ב-AI הסתיימה. כדי לקבל עוד, פנו אל dan.weibren@gmail.com» and no recipe draft; a fourth try shows the same toast again.

Still as the test user, open the AI recipe window: under the daily bar it says «נשארו לך 0 מתוך 2 קריאות AI». Back as the platform admin, raise the user to 5; the user's next AI try works and the line says «נשארו לך 2 מתוך 5 קריאות AI».

the screen's page with the data request failing · open the page · a readable error with a retry appears, not a blank page — here: as the platform admin, open `/dashboard?tab=metadata` with the server stopped (or the network off), change a user's «מכסת AI» and press «שמור»: a readable error toast «שגיאת שרת, נסה שוב מאוחר יותר» appears, not a blank page, the row keeps its old number and «שמור» can be pressed again to retry.
As the platform admin yourself, the AI recipe window says «קריאות AI ללא הגבלה (מנהל מערכת)» and AI keeps working whatever your own number is.
